title: Send from the client
summary: WebSockets: Send from the client. Send a different short message.
introduction: The open event means the connection is ready. Sending before it is ready can fail.
learningObjectives: Send from the client with WebSockets

blocks.text: Run npm init -y and npm install ws@8 in a practice folder. Save each example as lesson.mjs and run node lesson.mjs. Each file starts a local server and test client, prints a result, then closes both.

blocks.title: Send from the client

blocks.text: The client waits for open before sending Hi. The server prefixes the received text and sends it back.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Wait for open before calling send.
